goal.objective: FOCUSED_CONTEXT_V2. Create only tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd. Do not search the repository broadly. Start from tests/run_tests.gd, specifically test_neural_control_contract(), and scripts/cognition/agent.gd, specifically select_action(), set_neural_control(), accept_neural_decision(), neural_bridge_unavailable(), and utility_shadow_family(). Use the same real classes as run_tests.gd: preload res://scripts/world/world_state.gd and res://scripts/cognition/agent.gd. Build one standalone SceneTree test. Concrete recipe: create World and Agent; enable neural control; set body.physiology.state.hydration = 0.24; call body.update_drives(); set position = Vector3(-2.0, 0.0, 1.1), heading = Vector3.LEFT; sample senses. Confirm utility_shadow_family() is non-empty so the diagnostic legacy utility has an actionable family. Clear current, set phase='idle', call neural_bridge_unavailable('offline'), then select_action(). Assert current remains empty and thought == 'Väntar på NeuralBrain.'. Then accept a valid DRINK decision with a fresh request_id, call select_action(), and assert current.controller == 'neural', current.action == 'drink', current.target == 'o2'. Print PASS/FAIL lines and quit 0 only when all checks pass. Do not write data or report files. Do not modify production code. Once the one test file is generated, stop; no further repository exploration is permitted.
goal.pass_definition: tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd is the only changed file; the dedicated headless Godot test exits 0; it proves an actionable utility reference exists, proves NeuralBrain outage followed by select_action() does not fall back to utility and waits for NeuralBrain, and proves a subsequent valid DRINK neural decision resumes neural actuation to target o2. No repository artifact files are created.

validation.command: from pathlib import Path; import os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile; c=[]; env=os.environ.get('BIRDAI_GODOT_EXE') or os.environ.get('GODOT_BIN'); c += [env] if env else []; c += [shutil.which(n) for n in ('godot.exe','godot4.exe','Godot_console.exe','Godot_v4.3-stable_win64_console.exe')]; roots=[Path(r'C:\Godot'),Path(os.environ.get('LOCALAPPDATA',''))/'Programs'/'Godot',Path(os.environ.get('ProgramFiles',''))/'Godot',Path.home()/'Downloads',Path.home()/'Desktop']; found=next((Path(p) for p in c if p and Path(p).is_file()),None); found=found or next((p for root in roots if root and root.is_dir() for p in root.rglob('*.exe') if p.name.lower().startswith('godot')),None); assert found is not None, 'Godot executable not found'; print(f'GODOT_EXE: {found}'); test=Path(r'tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd'); assert test.is_file(), 'focused outage regression missing'; log=Path(tempfile.gettempdir())/'birdai-neural-outage-test.log'; r=subprocess.run([str(found),'--headless','--path','.','--log-file',str(log),'--script','res://tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd'],text=True,capture_output=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=90); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr,file=sys.stderr); assert r.returncode==0, f'Godot outage regression failed: {r.returncode}'; print('NEURAL_OUTAGE_REGRESSION: PASS')
